resolution.summary: Raise the consumer's version guard from `#if RCLCPP_VERSION_GTE(30, 1, 5)` to `#if RCLCPP_VERSION_GTE(31, 0, 0)` so that against rclcpp 30.1.5 the consumer overrides the by-value `add_node(rclcpp::node_interfaces::NodeBaseInterface::SharedPtr node_ptr, bool notify)` declaration (PR 3198 on master, merge 64f9645a; backports PR 3200 to jazzy, merge f69d26cbab8d66681838f1db2cb3929d93bc250b, and PR 3201 to kilted, merge 763ccbbed885bb445b8489d6bc716660ce1992a9).
resolution.evidence: The next scheduled Rolling Binary Build (run 24116710553, 2026-04-08, head 64f9645a) succeeded in both jobs, including "binary (rolling, main) / rolling main" -- https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/actions/runs/24116710553. The rclcpp revision installed in that run is not recorded in any readable source (logs expired), so the resolved composition is not identified by revision on the provider side.

notes: Direction caveat for E3: the provider in the failing composition is older than the revision the consumer's selected code was written against (consumer_built_against 31.0.0 vs provider 30.1.5); the consumer, not the provider, was the unit that changed (#3080 merged 2026-04-05, one day before the failing scheduled build). If UPGRADE is applied strictly as provider-newer-than-consumer, this case should be re-classified. consumer_built_against is inferred from the consumer's declarations: the broken consumer's selected override matches rclcpp 31.0.0's `add_node(const rclcpp::node_interfaces::NodeBaseInterface::SharedPtr & node_ptr, bool notify = true)`, the resolved consumer's selected override matches rclcpp 30.1.5's by-value declaration. Other provider changes between 30.1.5 and 31.0.0 (17 commits, including const-reference changes to add_callback_group, remove_callback_group and remove_node in f145c9ee) are visible to an inferred-revision diff. Related but distinct composition: ros2_control issue 3079 ("hardware_interface_testing build broke", 2026-03-04) is the forward UPGRADE in which the old by-value override failed to compile against rclcpp after f145c9ee ("https://github.com/ros2/rclcpp/pull/3079 introduced changes"); PR 3080 fixed that one and introduced this case's guard. The consumer file is a test source (hardware_interface_testing/test/test_resource_manager.cpp) of the hardware_interface_testing package; the job aborted controller_interface and transmission_interface only as a consequence of the build failure. The jazzy and kilted backports (PRs 3200, 3201) change the same guard; there the guard was not reached by jazzy/kilted rclcpp versions, and no failure is reported on those branches. The issue title says "rolling/main" and the body links the ros2_control run; the ros2_control_ci issue 733 reports the same failure from the ros2_control_ci scheduled build and was closed by the same PR.
